description: This Java source file defines the `PolicyTooLargeException` class, an exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a policy's size exceeds the allowed limit. It includes a nested builder class for constructing instances and methods for JSON serialization/deserialization. The class extends a runtime exception and implements custom behavior relevant to policy size violations.

classes.name: PolicyTooLargeException
classes.description: An immutable exception class indicating that a policy is too large to process, including mechanisms for creating, serializing, and deserializing instances.

classes.name: PolicyTooLargeException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of `PolicyTooLargeException` with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for `PolicyTooLargeException`, initialized with actual and maximum byte sizes.

methods.description: Deserializes a `PolicyTooLargeException` instance from a JSON object.

methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with the specified headers, copying existing message, description, cause, and href.
